name: Jishma
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Jishma is a person mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles. He is a descendant of Judah through Caleb and belongs to one of the less well-known family lines in Israel's tribal history. His name appears in the genealogical lists documenting Judah's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jishma is mentioned as one of the sons of Etam in the genealogy of Judah's descendants in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Part of Judah's Tribal Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jishma is included in the extensive genealogy describing Judah's descendants and their settlement patterns in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Bethlehem's Family Line
keyEvents.description: Through his father Etam, Jishma is linked to family lines connected with the Bethlehem area in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Descendants Documented
keyEvents.description: Jishma is part of the broader documentation of Caleb's descendants, who played an important role in the tribe of Judah.
